scraped.scraped_description: A CampaignLab 2024 Hackathon project to scrape and process OpenElections political campaigning leaflets and convert them into structured JSON files for further analysis using GPT-4 Vision. - thicknavyrain/uk_elections_leaflets

name: OpenElections Leaflet Scraper and Parser
tagline: A CampaignLab 2024 Hackathon project to scrape and process UK election campaign leaflets into structured JSON using GPT-4 Vision
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 – Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
dependency_risks: Reliance on OpenAI GPT-4 Vision API
Dependency on Open Elections archive availability
documented_limitations: Project relies on GPT-4 Vision API accuracy for leaflet parsing; limited to leaflets available in Open Elections archive; solo developer project with limited maintenance resources
failure_modes: API rate limiting or cost constraints; changes to Open Elections archive structure; GPT-4 Vision model updates affecting parsing accuracy
ai_involvement: GPT-4 Vision for leaflet parsing and JSON structuring
